title: SUTI.world architecture map
description: The author's map of SUTI.world modules and the proposed synaura × Syntaxium specification.
h1: A map of modules for getting things done
lead: The author's architecture for language, discernment, structure, and action. Modules are chosen according to the task. Their names alone establish no claim that a separate application exists.
scope: This page presents descriptions and a specification. A parser, metrics, telemetry, connected bots, or running services require separate confirmation.
cards: Eight dimensions proposed by the author for examining the value a design aims to create. They carry no guarantee of outcomes.
Work with available signals and keep observation distinct from explanation.
Maps of entities, images, relationships, and boundaries.
A research framework that brings together attention, imagery, action, and language.
A feasible step, what to look for afterward, and room to reconsider.
Attention, discernment, transition, pace, and cognitive load.
Combines modules into an interaction scenario. This description implies no background agents.
Proposed structure for records, relationships, scope, and status.
Intent, addressee, speech act, and the range of possible responses.
Speech registers, language and cultural practice, and sound in multimodal experiences.
A proposed way to turn meaning, relationships, and constraints into a form.
VereNITYA · Accessibility · Semantic Security · Sufficiency Gate
Evidence, accessibility, data boundaries, and whether the structure is sufficient. Accessibility compliance requires a separate assessment.
Market Evidence · Claim Ceiling · Copy Protocol
Evidence, limits on promises, and wording proportionate to the evidence.
Consent, refusal, pause, clarification, change, and exit.
Trickster Red Team · SUTI Observatory · RAD
Alternative interpretations, an observable record, and revision.
Spatial and interface forms of the work, with a shared public setting for the project.
A browser-based workshop for finding your way that works offline. The page itself makes no claim about a hosted agent or an active Telegram bot.
Optional paths for play and reflection. They offer no diagnosis, prediction, or classification of people.
A way to organize a question, its grounds, objections, and revisions. The worksheet supports deliberation without voting, a consensus mechanism, or an integrated meeting system.

A guidance role conceived by the author, with editorial resources. A multilingual practice page is available. The questionnaire is hosted on a separate external platform, and the multilingual handoff package is still under editorial review.
Activation manifest, core principles, style canon, Syntaxium grammar, and operator registry.
Eidographics and visual DNA, parser and canonical AST, token economy, and runtime.
Research protocol, validation and metrics, reference architecture, and ASCII design system.
numericNote: Numerical thresholds and formulas from early drafts are published as proposals. The detailed specification preserves that status and identifies unresolved fields.
styleNote: This separate public candidate offers optional editorial guidance for writing on SUTI.world. The proposed formal language and runtime specification for synaura is a separate document.
versionNote: The public catalog describes the author's architecture in version 2026.11-r5. Adopting it as canonical requires a separate human decision. Check changes in status or implementation against the relevant source and version.
review: Editorial translation. Independent review by native English speakers is pending.
